'''Kane''' is a character in the [[Grand Theft Auto]] series who appears as a minor character in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He is one of the leading members of the Front Yard sub-sect of the [[Ballas]] gang. He does not speak during his [[Los Sepulcros|only appearance]].

==Character history==
Kane, presumably born in [[Los Santos in GTA III Era|Los Santos]], at an unknown time joined the [[Ballas]] gang and rose to prominence within the gang, later becoming one the highest ranking gangsters of the Front Yard sub-sect, being described by rival [[Grove Street Families]] coleader and protagonist [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] as 'Front Yard royalty'. In [[1992]], Kane attends the funeral of [[Little Weasel]], who [[Doberman|died trying]] to keep [[Glen Park]] a Ballas territory. The funeral, however, is ambushed by Carl and his brother, [[Grove Street Families]] leader and deuteragonist [[Sweet|Sean "Sweet" Johnson]], in retaliation for the Ballas ambushing their mother [[Beverly Johnson|Beverly's]] [[Sweet & Kendl|funeral]]. The two then [[Los Sepulcros|attack and manage to kill]] all the attending Ballas gangsters, including Kane.

==Trivia==
*Kane does not have a unique character model, sharing his design with one of the normal Ballas gangster models.
